sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
"Ahh, my study! How I've missed it.
Everything seems to be intact, for the most part. Good, good…
Oh, this? Notes and research, mostly.
Hmm? You say I'm neater than this scientist friend of yours?
Haha! Well, I don't mean to boast, but even my patients can read my handwriting."
— Theodor in Manor of Horrors

Theodor is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. He is a wandering doctor

sections.title: Debut Appearance
sections.content: As an NPC character, Theodor first appears in the Manor of Horrors.
